key_features: Dual-Channel Recording: Includes two transmitters (TX) and one receiver (RX) for capturing audio from multiple sources simultaneously.
Omnidirectional Microphones: Integrated omnidirectional microphones ensure crystal-clear audio from all directions.
Long Battery Life: Built-in rechargeable batteries with a 320 mAh capacity offer up to 5.5 hours of continuous recording.
Fast Charging: Fully charges in just 70 minutes using the convenient charging case, ensuring minimal downtime.
Versatile Applications: Ideal for interviews, vlogging, filmmaking, live streaming, and other professional audio recording needs.
Durable Build: Designed for reliability and long-lasting performance, suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.
